name: Sidereal-Verge

civilization.name: The Pale Assemblies
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by towering mountain ranges near the terminator.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
